speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Strategy Group will continue to lead the Public Service to develop and implement strategic priorities and tackle long-term national challenges, to build a better Singapore for all.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We begin this new term of Government in a more uncertain, fragmented and dangerous world.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We have to contend with a changing global order, big power contestation and a more volatile economic outlook, which present headwinds for a small and open economy like Singapore.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We must be nimble and adapt quickly, to continue to secure good outcomes and seize new opportunities for Singapore and Singaporeans.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Strategy Group will drive whole-of-Government efforts to implement our national priorities, while ensuring that agencies work together to address critical cross-cutting issues, achieve greater synergies and manage trade-offs optimally across policy domains.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: At the same time, the Strategy Group will sharpen foresight and sense-making to better anticipate future challenges and opportunities and develop robust strategies in response.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: In this term, we will do more to help parents better manage their work and family commitments and work with stakeholders such as employers and community partners to build a culture that celebrates and values families.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: As our seniors live healthier and longer lives, we will do more to harness longevity as an opportunity.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Government will continue to support seniors to lead active and healthy lives, stay employed if they wish and age with confidence.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also enhance our built environment and service provisions, so our seniors can be well cared for in their homes and connected to their communities.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our foreign workforce and immigration policies play an important role in mitigating the impact of low birth rates and ageing, on the economy and society.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Government will carefully manage our foreign worker and immigration flows, while helping newcomers integrate into our society.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also work with stakeholders to support new citizens in connecting with their local communities and building stronger bonds.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Continued investment in climate action is critical for Singapore’s long-term competitiveness and survival.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: First, we will work to decarbonise our energy mix, by advancing domestic solar deployment, pursuing cross-border electricity trade and considering potential green energy solutions like geothermal and nuclear for the future.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Second, we will continue to pursue key mitigation measures such as carbon capture, utilisation and storage.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Third, we will work with industry to develop robust transition plans for businesses.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: At the same time, Singapore will need to prepare for the growing physical impact of climate change, especially rising sea levels and heat.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: In addition to our existing plans on coastal protection, we will work with businesses and other stakeholders to strengthen climate adaptation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This includes boosting heat resilience and partnering neighbouring countries to tackle transboundary climate risks.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: To support Singapore’s efforts, global cooperation and action is essential.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Government’s ability to work in an integrated and collaborative way, as well as to think ahead and plan for the long term, has served us well and will remain essential.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: As we navigate the challenges ahead, the Strategy Group will continue to lead the Public Service in advancing today’s priorities, while preparing for tomorrow’s possibilities.
